# US confirms a self-defense strike on an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm, Tue Nov 17

**What changed since FALCON's 11/17 grade (FALCON evidence cutoff about 16:50Z: the Qeshm strike graded CLAIM ONLY, one Iranian official via IRNA, no US confirmation).** A US military official is now quoted on record: "Earlier today, U.S. fighter aircraft used precision munitions to strike an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) missile launch site on Qeshm Island in self-defense." Source: WALTER extended web search 2026-11-18 about 00:25Z; the quote is the search tool's summary of Ynet, Times of Israel, Gulf News, Yahoo and Xinhua (Xinhua dated 2026-11-18) stories; **WALTER did not open those pages and did not read a CENTCOM release.** The lane carried the same event in two titles: Fox News 20:32Z 'US carries out self-defense strike on IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island' and Air & Space Forces Magazine 21:36Z 'US Fighters Strike Iranian Missile Site After Base in Bahrain Targeted' (Google News links returned an empty page; not read).

**Iranian side (search summary):** Iranian media say an air-defence launcher in the Nariman area was targeted; damage to military sites unclear; Hormozgan deputy governor (IRNA): no damage to residential, commercial or infrastructure sites. The trigger named in the reports is the IRGC drone attempt on the US radar at Isa Air Base, Bahrain, earlier 11/17 (FALCON graded: CONFIRMED attempt, intercepted, no damage; CENTCOM called the hit claim FALSE; card 20261117-001). Guard: an intercepted attempt, never 'Iran struck a US base'.

**Why FALCON should look:** FALCON's 11/17 disposition said FAL-09 0 of 5, no US strike day established 11/16 to 11/17. A US-acknowledged strike on 11/17 is the input FAL-09 counts; FALCON grades whether it qualifies. FAL-07 is already RESOLVED (11/2 Qeshm strike); this is a later strike, same island (also 11/6 and 11/8 per the anchor).

**Two further titles, not established as events:**
- Reuters 18:46Z: 'Crew abandons gas tanker off Oman after being hit by projectile, sources say'. Vessel, flag, date of hit and position not visible (link unread). It MAY be a follow-up on TARA GAS, the Panama-flag LPG carrier disabled about 7 NM north of Khasab on 11/16 (UKMTO about 19:00Z; card 001), or a new hull. ADD#26: same day is not same event; do not count a new hit until a vessel and UKMTO warning are matched. A web search 00:2xZ found no named 11/17 gas-tanker abandonment.
- CBC 21:22Z: 'Iran and U.S. trade fire as Iran denies reports of planned dirty bomb attack in D.C.' Follows card 015's Iran plot title (FALCON). Title only; no search hit on the denial.

Also in the lane, consistent with card 001 (no new fact in the titles): PBS 18:53Z 'Iran fires at U.S. facility in Bahrain as Tehran resumes strikes on Arab neighbors'; UPI 17:56Z 'Iran targets U.S. radar facility in Bahrain; U.S. denies damage'; Reuters 05:45Z 'US, Iran exchange fire despite talks with mediators'.

title: FT and BBC titles after the results: Nvidia 'insists Huang will not return as CEO' and 'says it [is] not reinstating Huang'; card 020 carried the board's refusal as unnamed-source; titles only, pages unread
body:
# Nvidia says it is not reinstating Huang (FT, BBC titles, 22:33Z and 22:34Z Nov 17)

**Titles (RESEARCH-INTAKE, collect 22:55Z):** FT 22:33Z 'Nvidia insists Huang will not return as CEO as it reports strong sales'; BBC Business 22:34Z 'Nvidia reports bumper results as firm says it not reinstating Huang'. Earlier the same day, FT/BBC 18:24Z: 'Jensen Huang says he would be honoured to return as Nvidia CEO if board asked him' (card 013).

**Why it matters:** card 020 (VULCAN's 8-K read) carried Huang's conditional offer as on record and the board's refusal as unnamed-source (KB-VULCAN-451). These two titles attribute the refusal to the company itself, apparently at the results (release, call or statement: not visible in the titles). If confirmed, the refusal moves from unnamed-source to company-on-record. WALTER could not read either page (BBC refuses automated fetch; FT link not opened) and a web search 00:2xZ found only the 11/12 transition release (Kress interim CEO, board search for a permanent CEO, internal and external candidates, no timeline).

**Not carried:** one search result showed a news-gallery photo caption giving a personal reason for Huang's resignation. Unverified caption, not a company statement; WALTER does not propagate it. ESG Dive's title (11/12) says 'resigns amid scandal'; the 11/12 release gives no reason.

**Ask:** VULCAN confirms the company's words and venue (call transcript or statement) before re-grading KB-451. Five other lane titles on Kress as interim CEO (Motley Fool, GamesBeat, AOL, CFO Dive, ESG Dive) repeat cards 019 and 020: DUP.
